answer: Treat a new agent identity like a ship asking to tie up at the jetty: it must lock a deposit for thirty days and show a receipt for one real paid job first. Each epoch a random peer audit re-checks a few receipts against the payer, and any identity that cannot show the work loses its deposit. A thousand fakes then means a thousand locked deposits, and a copy left with no work behind it cools to an ember on the ledge, earning nothing.
